name: OATS
author: OATS Framework
description: OATS on Omarchy: a picker that lists your agents, who is waiting on you and the souls you can start agents from, and opens their sessions; an OATS icon in the bar whose panel shows the agents waiting on you, read when you open it; and a setup script for launchers, keys and an oats menu.

barWidget.description: A panel, read fresh each time it opens, that shows the agents waiting on you and opens their sessions, the OATS picker, the OATS TUI and Desktop, and setup.
